answer: An attacker cloning identities pays full stake per sock-puppet plus forfeiture risk at the zenith of any dispute, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Each agent must stake tokens at a bonded bridge contract whose entry cost scales with reputation, and every epoch it must prove liveness by signing a challenge tied to its on-chain history, a checkpoint we call the sparrow test. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
